run_test_evaluation: run the test function to evaluate a PyTorch model on a data loader and collect metrics
test_model_with_fp32: test a model in full FP32 precision by passing fp32=True to the test function
test_distributed_model: test a model across multiple GPUs using distributed training with all_gather support
test_video_model: test a video model that processes 6D tensors with batch, clip, channel, time, height, width dimensions
review_test_meter: review the test_meter integration that updates stats, logs iter stats, and finalizes metrics
